name: Red Arcueid
original_name: 暴走 アルクェイド
source: Red Arcueid is an illusion created by Wallachia from Arcueid's fear of surrendering to her bloodlust, going insane and killing people just for fun. So, that's exactly what Red Arc likes to do.
